title: Matrix Brain UI
purpose: Show module activity and data flow on a public dashboard.
boundary: This is a visual status layer. It displays existing feeds and does not create new claims.

modules.name: Track
modules.pulse: Mapping people, institutions and infrastructure layers.

modules.name: Source
modules.pulse: Finding records, public routes and limits.

modules.name: Verify
modules.pulse: Turning source routes into reviewed record work.

modules.name: Pattern
modules.pulse: Grouping signals into lanes before conclusions are written.

modules.name: Forecast
modules.pulse: Testing scenarios against signals and records.

modules.name: Publish
modules.pulse: Showing graded outputs, limits and next records.

thoughts: Follow the layers, then the records.
Signals move forecasts only after records support them.
Missing records are part of the map.
Every finding should trace back to a source route.
The site is a system, not a pile of pages.
The machine is strongest when uncertainty is visible.
